description_en: Configures an X number to individually set up communication features such as voice calls and enterprise name cards for the work number
description_zh: 配置X号码，单独对工作号的话音呼叫、企业名片等通信功能进行配置操作
name: ConfigX

parameters.help_en: The request deduplication ID. The maximum length of reqId is 20 characters. The caller must ensure atomicity
parameters.help_zh: 请求去重ID，reqId最大长度为20位，接入方需要保持原子性
parameters.name: req_id

parameters.example: 系统自动获取，无需输入。
parameters.name: caller_parent_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pass through the caller ID as the real caller. Valid values:

00: non-passthrough. The work number is displayed when both parties call each other.

10: passthrough. When customer A is the caller, the caller ID displayed to employee B is customer A's number. When employee B is the caller, the caller ID displayed to customer A is the work number.

Default value: 00
parameters.help_zh:
是否透传来显为真实主叫，取值：

00：非透传，互相拨打时都显示工作号。

10：透传，A客户为主叫时，B员工的来显为客户A号码；B员工为主叫时，A客户的来显为工作号。

默认为 00
parameters.name: gn_flag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pass through the caller ID as the real user. Valid values:

0: non-passthrough.

1: passthrough.

Default value: 0 (non-passthrough)
parameters.help_zh:
是否透传来显为真实用户，取值：

0：不透传。

1：透传。

默认为0不透传
parameters.name: sms_sign_mode

parameters.help_en:
Enables or disables the SMS feature. Valid values:

0: disabled.

1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
开/关短信功能状态，取值：

0：禁用。

1：开启
parameters.name: sms_ability

parameters.help_en:
Enables or disables the call capability. Valid values:

0: disabled.

1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
开/关呼叫能力状态，取值：

0：禁用。

1：开启
parameters.name: call_ability

parameters.help_en:
The sequential ringing mode. Valid values:

0: no sequential ringing (default).

1: conditional sequential ringing. The system first connects to the called party specified by calledNo. If the called party cannot be reached, the system sequentially rings the numbers in the sequenceCalls list.

2: unconditional sequential ringing. The system does not connect to the called party specified by calledNo and directly rings the numbers in the sequenceCalls list
parameters.help_zh:
顺振模式，取值：

0：不顺振（默认）

1：有条件顺振，先接续calledNo指定被叫，如果该被叫未能接通，再顺振sequenceCalls号码列表。

2：无条件顺振，不接续calledNo指定被叫，直接顺振sequenceCalls号码列表
parameters.name: sequence_mode

fields.help_en: The prompt tone code for sequential ringing. The format is the same as callNoPlayCode
fields.help_zh: 顺振提示音放音编号，格式如callNoPlayCode
fields.name: sequence_call_no_play_code

fields.help_en: The called number for sequential ringing
fields.name: sequence_called_no

fields.help_en: The tone code played to the caller and called party after the call is connected. The format is the same as calledPlayCode
fields.help_zh: 接通后主被叫放音编号，格式如calledPlayCode
fields.name: sequence_called_play_code
